questions.question:
A Kustomize base for the parcel index service is on this machine at `/tmp/exam/q1/base`. It builds a Deployment named `parcel-index` with `2` replicas, and a Service of the same name.

Create an overlay at `/tmp/exam/q1/overlays/dev` that builds on that base and:

- places every resource in the `kustom-intro` namespace
- suffixes every resource name with `-dev`
- adds the annotation `owner: platform-team` to every resource it produces

Apply the overlay. Both `2` replicas must become ready.

Do not edit anything under `/tmp/exam/q1/base`.

verification.description: The suffixed Deployment and Service exist and are ready
The annotation reached both the Deployment and the Service
The base is unchanged

questions.question:
A Kustomize base is on this machine at `/tmp/exam/q2/base`. It builds a Deployment named `depot-config` whose container reads its environment from a ConfigMap named `app-settings`.

A reporting tool outside this Kustomize configuration reads the two generated objects below by their exact names, so neither may carry a generated name suffix.

Create an overlay at `/tmp/exam/q2/overlays/prod` that builds on that base and:

- places every resource in the `kustom-gen` namespace
- generates a ConfigMap named `app-settings` holding exactly two keys: `DEPOT_REGION` with the value `north`, and `MAX_PARCELS` with the value `5000`
- generates an `Opaque` Secret named `depot-ca` holding exactly one key, `ca.crt`, whose content is read from the file `/tmp/exam/q2/overlays/prod/depot-ca.pem`
- produces both of them without a name suffix hash

Apply the overlay. The `depot-config` Deployment must become ready.

Both objects must be generated by Kustomize rather than written out by hand, and you must not edit anything under `/tmp/exam/q2/base`.

verification.description: ConfigMap app-settings is generated, unsuffixed, with the expected keys
Secret depot-ca is built from the file and unsuffixed
The depot-config Deployment is running

questions.question:
A Kustomize base at `/tmp/exam/q3/base` builds three Deployments: `route-planner` and `dispatch-worker`, both labelled `tier: backend`, and `driver-portal`, labelled `tier: frontend`. Each of them runs a single container named `app`.

Create an overlay at `/tmp/exam/q3/overlays/prod` that builds on that base and:

- places every resource in the `kustom-patch` namespace
- adds the environment variable `SHIFT_WINDOW` with the value `night` to the `app` container of every Deployment labelled `tier: backend`, and of no other Deployment

The patch must choose its targets by label. Do not name the individual Deployments anywhere in the overlay, and do not edit anything under `/tmp/exam/q3/base`.

Apply the overlay.

verification.description: Both tier=backend Deployments carry the variable and are ready
The frontend Deployment was left untouched
The patch selects its targets by label, not by name

questions.question:
Two independent Kustomize bases are on this machine: `/tmp/exam/q4/bases/app`, which builds a Deployment and a Service both named `waybill-api`, and `/tmp/exam/q4/bases/cache`, which builds a Deployment named `waybill-cache`.

Create a single overlay at `/tmp/exam/q4/overlays/prod` that builds on both bases and:

- places every resource in the `kustom-compose` namespace
- adds the label `release: winter-2026` to every resource it produces, without altering any Deployment's selector
- runs `waybill-cache` with `2` replicas, leaving `waybill-api` at `1`

Apply the overlay. Every replica must become ready.

Do not edit anything under `/tmp/exam/q4/bases`.

verification.description: Both bases are composed into the namespace and running
The shared label reached resources from both bases
Only the cache was resized

questions.question:
Running `kubectl kustomize /tmp/exam/q5/overlays/staging` on this machine exits with an error and produces no output.

The base under `/tmp/exam/q5/base` is shared with other teams and must not be edited. Only the `staging` overlay is yours, and it must keep using both of the files it already contains, `container-patch.yaml` and `replica-patch.yaml`.

Repair the overlay, then apply it.

When you are finished the `kustom-repair` namespace must hold a Deployment named `customs-check` with `4` ready replicas and exactly one container, named `checker`, running the approved image `nginx:1.27.4`. The namespace must also hold a generated ConfigMap whose name begins with `checker-settings`, carrying the key `MODE` with the value `strict`.

verification.description: The overlay builds successfully
The applied Deployment has one correct container, 4 ready replicas and its ConfigMap
Both patch files still exist and are still referenced
The base is unchanged

questions.question:
The nodes of this cluster carry a `node-class` label describing the hardware they provide, and any node being retired additionally carries a `decommission` label.

In the `sched-nodeaff` namespace, create a Deployment named `sorting-engine` with `2` replicas. Each Pod must run a single container named `engine` using the image `nginx:1.27.4`.

Its Pods may be placed only on nodes whose `node-class` is either `compute` or `memory`, and never on a node that carries a `decommission` label, whatever that label's value.

Express the whole requirement as node affinity that is required during scheduling, inside a single node selector term. Do not use a `nodeSelector`.

All `2` replicas must become ready.

verification.description: One term requires the allowed classes and excludes decommissioning nodes
All replicas are ready and only on eligible nodes

questions.question:
Every node of this cluster carries a `topology.kubernetes.io/zone` label, whose value is either `edge-1` or `edge-2`.

In the `sched-prefer` namespace, create a Deployment named `tracking-api` with `3` replicas. Each Pod must run a single container named `api` using the image `nginx:1.27.4`.

The scheduler should favour one zone over the other, but must never be prevented from placing a Pod:

- a preference for zone `edge-1` with weight `70`
- a preference for zone `edge-2` with weight `30`

Express this as node affinity carrying exactly those two weighted preferences, and no required node affinity at all.

All `3` replicas must become ready.

verification.description: Exactly two weighted preferences, with the expected weights and zones
No required node affinity is declared
All 3 replicas are ready

questions.question:
The `sched-antiaff` namespace runs a latency-sensitive Deployment named `scan-gateway`, whose Pods carry the label `app=scan-gateway` and are pinned to one node. It belongs to another team and must not be modified.

In the same namespace, create a Deployment named `label-printer` with `2` replicas. Each Pod must run a single container named `printer` using the image `nginx:1.27.4`.

A `label-printer` Pod must never be scheduled onto a node that is running a `scan-gateway` Pod. Express this as pod anti-affinity that is required during scheduling, on the `kubernetes.io/hostname` topology key.

Both `label-printer` replicas must become ready.

verification.description: The anti-affinity rule selects the protected workload on the hostname key
Both replicas are ready
No replica shares a node with the protected workload

questions.question:
A collector Deployment named `depot-telemetry` runs in the `sched-podaff-infra` namespace. Its Pods carry the label `app=depot-telemetry` and are pinned to one node. It must not be modified.

In the `sched-podaff` namespace, create a Deployment named `depot-agent` with `2` replicas. Each Pod must run a single container named `agent` using the image `nginx:1.27.4`.

Every `depot-agent` Pod must be scheduled onto the same node as the collector, because it reads a host socket the collector writes. Express this as pod affinity that is required during scheduling, on the `kubernetes.io/hostname` topology key.

Both `2` replicas must become ready.

verification.description: The pod affinity selects the collector and names its namespace
Both replicas are ready
Every replica shares the collector's node

questions.question:
Every node of this cluster carries a `topology.kubernetes.io/zone` label. The zones do not hold the same number of nodes.

In the `sched-spread` namespace, create a Deployment named `parcel-tracker` with `4` replicas. Each Pod must run a single container named `tracker` using the image `nginx:1.27.4`, and every Pod must carry the label `app=parcel-tracker`.

Spread the Pods using exactly two topology spread constraints. Both must use a maximum skew of `1` and both must select the Pods labelled `app=parcel-tracker`:

- one across `topology.kubernetes.io/zone`, where an uneven spread must prevent scheduling
- one across `kubernetes.io/hostname`, where an uneven spread must be tolerated

All `4` replicas must become ready.

verification.description: Exactly two constraints, hard across zones and soft across hosts
All 4 replicas are ready
The replicas are spread across zones within the skew

questions.question:
The `customs-broker` Deployment in the `ts-sched` namespace is configured for `3` replicas, but none of its Pods ever reach the `Running` state.

The node inventory of this cluster is maintained by another team. The `node-class` labels already on the nodes are correct: you must not change them, remove them, or add new ones. The node classes approved for this application are `compute` and `memory`.

Investigate the Deployment and restore it to a healthy state.

When you are finished all `3` replicas must be ready, the Deployment must still declare `3` replicas, and it must still choose its nodes through node affinity rather than through a `nodeSelector`.

verification.description: All 3 replicas are running and ready
The node labels are unchanged
The Deployment keeps its replica count and its node affinity

questions.question:
A Kustomize base at `/tmp/exam/q12/base` builds a Deployment named `freight-api` with `1` replica, whose Pods carry the label `app=freight-api` and which declares no scheduling rules of any kind. The application team owns that base and it must not be edited.

Placement policy belongs to the platform team, and is expressed in the overlay instead.

Create an overlay at `/tmp/exam/q12/overlays/prod` that builds on that base, places every resource in the `kustom-sched` namespace, and adds to the Deployment:

- pod anti-affinity, required during scheduling, on the `kubernetes.io/hostname` topology key, selecting the Pods labelled `app=freight-api`
- one topology spread constraint across `topology.kubernetes.io/zone` with a maximum skew of `1`, selecting the Pods labelled `app=freight-api`, where an uneven spread must be tolerated

The overlay must also raise the workload from `1` replica to `3`.

Apply the overlay. All `3` replicas must become ready.

verification.description: The overlay adds the required anti-affinity
The overlay adds the zone spread constraint
The overlay sets the replica count to 3
All 3 replicas are ready
The replicas occupy 3 distinct nodes
The base is unchanged
